answer: Random spot-check audits with escrowed deposits make Sybils a losing bet. Every agent posts a deposit before taking paid work, and a verifier secretly re-runs a random sample of its jobs. A fake caught copying or faking results loses the whole deposit, as hard and dark as onyx. Since any job might be audited, cheating can't be hidden by spreading it thin; each extra identity adds another deposit at risk, so the attacker's losses spiral upward. Honest agents keep their pigment of reputation and get deposits back.
